description: Manage Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud: create and update customer tenants and users, check usage, follow backups and other tasks, read and dismiss alerts, see workloads' protection status, and apply or run protection plans. Start workflows on new alerts, finished tasks, and new tenants, users or workloads.

acronis_alert_dismissed_trigger.description: Runs for each Acronis alert that is dismissed, by a person or because the problem cleared, such as to close a matching ticket.

output.alert_id: The alert's id, for 'Get alert' or 'Dismiss alert'.
output.category: The alert's category, such as Backup.
output.dismissed_at: When it was dismissed, if it was.
output.title: The alert's title, such as Backup failed.

parameters.description: Only alerts this severe or worse: information, warning, error or critical. Leave blank for every alert.
parameters.name: severity

parameters.description: Only alerts in this category, such as Backup. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: category

acronis_new_alert_trigger.description: Runs for each new Acronis alert, such as a failed backup or malware found. Alerts raised before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.alert_id: The alert's id, for 'Get alert' or 'Dismiss alert'.
output.category: The alert's category, such as Backup.
output.dismissed_at: When it was dismissed, if it was.
output.title: The alert's title, such as Backup failed.

parameters.description: Only alerts this severe or worse: information, warning, error or critical. Leave blank for every alert.
parameters.name: severity

parameters.description: Only alerts in this category, such as Backup. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: category

acronis_new_resource_trigger.description: Runs for each new workload Acronis sees, such as a machine where an agent was just installed, so a plan can be applied to it.

output.name: Its name.
output.resource_id: The workload's id, for 'Apply protection plan'.

parameters.description: Only this tenant's workloads. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.description: Only this type, such as resource.machine. Leave blank for every type.
parameters.name: resource_type

acronis_new_tenant_trigger.description: Runs for each tenant created directly under a tenant, such as a new customer. Tenants there before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Watch the tenants under this one. Leave blank for the tenant your API client belongs to.
parameters.name: parent_tenant_id

parameters.description: Only this kind: customer, partner, folder or unit. Leave blank for every kind.
parameters.name: tenant_kind

acronis_new_user_trigger.description: Runs for each user account created in a tenant or any tenant under it. Users there before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.user_id: The new user's id, for 'Get user'.

parameters.description: Watch this tenant and every tenant under it. Leave blank for the tenant your API client belongs to.
parameters.name: tenant_id

acronis_task_finished_trigger.description: Runs for each Acronis task that finishes, such as a backup, optionally only those that failed or a single plan's. Tasks that finished before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.plan_id: The protection plan that started it.
output.result: How it ended: ok, warning, error, cancelled or timedout.
output.type: What kind of task it was.

parameters.description: Only tasks that ended this way: ok, warning, error, cancelled, abandoned or timedout. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: result

parameters.description: Only tasks this protection plan started. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: plan_id
